title: Moment.inEDTF
description: Position of a Moment, expressed in EDTF. Use http://id.loc.gov/datatypes/edtf/EDTF as the data type of the Literal and a String in EDTF format as the value. EDTF is a comprehensive set of formats for capturing dates, times, and time intervals, including uncertain or approximate dates, repeating dates, and open time intervals. Examples: 1980/1984 (period 1980-1984), 1984? (year uncertain), 1984~ (year approximate), 19XX (20th century), /1980 (period with unknown beginning), 1984 (sometime in 1984). See EDTF for more info.
